form.label: Authentication & Access Control
form.description: Monitor authentication activity and detect credential abuse

search.query: (index=linux sourcetype=linux_secure "Failed password") OR (index=windows EventCode=4625) OR (index=network sourcetype=syslog "authentication failed") | eval auth_source=case( sourcetype=="linux_secure", "Linux SSH", EventCode==4625, "Windows Login", 1=1, "Network Device" ) | timechart span=10m count by auth_source

panel.title: SSH Brute Force Detection (10+ Failures → Success)

search.query: index=linux sourcetype=linux_secure ("Failed password" OR "Accepted password" OR "Accepted publickey") | rex field=_raw "from (?<src_ip>\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)" | rex field=_raw "for (invalid user )?(?<username>\w+)" | eval auth_result=if(match(_raw, "Accepted"), "success", "failure") | stats count(eval(auth_result="failure")) as failures, count(eval(auth_result="success")) as successes, earliest(_time) as first_attempt, latest(_time) as last_success by src_ip, username | where failures >= 10 AND successes > 0 | eval attack_duration=tostring(last_success-first_attempt, "duration") | convert ctime(first_attempt) ctime(last_success) | sort -failures | rename src_ip as "Attacker IP", username as "Compromised User", failures as "Failed Attempts", successes as "Successful Logins", first_attempt as "First Failure", last_success as "Successful Login", attack_duration as "Attack Duration"

(index=linux sourcetype=linux_secure "Failed password") OR (index=windows EventCode=4625) | rex field=_raw "from (?<src_ip>\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)" | eval src_ip=coalesce(src_ip, Source_Network_Address, IpAddress) | stats count as failures by src_ip, user, host | sort -failures | rename src_ip as "Source IP", user as "Target User", host as "Target Host", failures as "Failed Attempts" | head 50

(index=linux sourcetype=linux_secure "Accepted password" OR "Accepted publickey") OR (index=windows EventCode=4624 Logon_Type!=3) | rex field=_raw "from (?<src_ip>\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)" | eval src_ip=coalesce(src_ip, Source_Network_Address, IpAddress) | stats count as successful_logins by src_ip, user, host | sort -successful_logins | rename src_ip as "Source IP", user as "Username", host as "Target Host", successful_logins as "Successful Logins" | head 30

(index=linux sourcetype=linux:audit type=USER_CMD) OR (index=linux sourcetype=linux_secure "sudo:") OR (index=windows EventCode=4720 OR EventCode=4728 OR EventCode=4732) | eval activity=case( sourcetype=="linux:audit", "Command: " . command, match(_raw, "sudo:"), "Sudo: " . _raw, EventCode==4720, "User Created: " . TargetUserName, EventCode==4728, "User Added to Global Group: " . TargetUserName, EventCode==4732, "User Added to Local Group: " . TargetUserName, 1=1, "Unknown" ) | table _time, host, user, activity | sort -_time | head 50

panel.title: Persistence Mechanisms (New Users, Cron, Scheduled Tasks)

search.query: (index=linux sourcetype=linux_secure ("useradd" OR "usermod" OR "groupadd")) OR (index=linux sourcetype=syslog "crontab" ("REPLACE" OR "LIST")) OR (index=windows EventCode=4698) OR (index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" EventCode=11 TargetFilename="*\\Startup\\*") | eval persistence_type=case( match(_raw, "useradd|usermod|groupadd"), "Linux User/Group Change", match(_raw, "crontab"), "Cron Modification", EventCode==4698, "Scheduled Task: " . TaskName, EventCode==11, "Startup Persistence: " . TargetFilename, 1=1, "Other" ) | table _time, host, user, persistence_type | sort -_time | rename persistence_type as "Activity" | head 50

index=network sourcetype=syslog (openvpn OR ipsec OR charon) | rex field=_raw "(?<vpn_user>\w+)\/(?<vpn_ip>\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)" | stats count as connections, earliest(_time) as first_conn, latest(_time) as last_conn by vpn_user, vpn_ip | convert ctime(first_conn) ctime(last_conn) | sort -connections | rename vpn_user as "VPN User", vpn_ip as "Remote IP", connections as "Connections", first_conn as "First", last_conn as "Last"
